blocks.text: 13.7 The fission properties of ^239_94 Pu are very similar to those of ^235_92 U . The average energy released per fission is 180 MeV. How much energy, in MeV, is released if all the atoms in 1 kg of pure ^239_94 Pu undergo fission?

13.10 From the relation R = R₀A^1/3, where R₀ is a constant and A is the mass number of a nucleus, show that the nuclear matter density is nearly constant (i.e. independent of A).
